* [Visit our **website**](https://www.pnwcubing.com)
* [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.pnwcubing.com/competitions)
* [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085)
* [Follow us on **Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/pnwcubing/)
* [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/Z54vZUurHm)

By registering for this competition, you should be aware of the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and this specific competitions [Competitor Responsibilites](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PNWCompTemplate2024#43238-please-read-competitor-responsibilities).

**Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of PNW Cubing competitions consent to their images being used by PNW cubing and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

**Note** 3x3 is not the main event of this competition! It is still being held, but the winner of 2x2 will be the declared the winner of this competition!

items.information:
You MUST read the required tabs on the website before registering for the competition. These tabs pertain to your responsibilities as a competitior. The competitor limit for this competition is 100 competitors, so be sure to register quick to get a spot!

We will be holding an unoffical round of FTO. Please check the "FTO" tab for more info.

items.name: Morrow Quiet Mania 2026
items.information:
This competition takes place on **SATURDAY** and only features Clock, FMC, and Blindfolded events. Therefore, it may not be suitable for newer competitors. Please click [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MorrowMixupMania2026) to view the page for the Morrow Mixup Mania 2026 competition which does feature 3x3, or see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Ohio. 

You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook group: [Ohio and Michigan Speedcubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1655301714974534/)

Morrow Quiet Mania 2026 is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](www.midwestcubing.org)
